profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: Detail-oriented full-stack developer dedicated to crafting polished, high-performing applications. With expertise in both front-end and back-end technologies, I bring innovation and efficiency to every project.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Implement cutting-edge tools and technologies to improve post-production and real-time editing capabilities.
- Develop and maintain software solutions that streamline video editing workflows for news and television broadcasts.
- Troubleshoot and resolve Technical issues using Typescript, Node, on a massive MonoRepo in charge of maintaining Legacy operations for all of NBC.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Integrate new dynamic features using Typescript at Carshop.com
- Build resolvers and queries in Graphql to communicate with data sources from CosmosDB.
- Project various solutions with UX/UI teams and architects.
- Learn dynamics of various AWS services.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
- Develop Licensing software for the Nebraska Department of Health using the Visual Vault platform.
- Build client/server side webservices using NodeJs & Javascript, to create custom functional forms.
- Utilize various in house and outsourced API’s using RESTful principles, and SQL to create dashboards.
- Custom modals, address validation services, and financial payment systems are some of the top achievements.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description: - Build and organize entire frontend, in React for an OKR.

positions.title: Wyncode TA
positions.description:
- Help students with coding and provide support via 1on1 or group
- Support with React, JS, HTML, CSS, and Ruby on Rails Git/Github, and Agile Methodologies.
- Provide feedback to staff on students to provide necessary guidance

positions.title: Web
positions.description: • Build voteByMail site in NextJs, sendGrid, and Firebase

positions.title: IT Support Specialist
positions.description: IT Support and EDI (Electronic Data Interchange) Support Specialist
